message: EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA (line 32) is the only content of 01 WS-DB2-AREA (line 31), and the SQLCA copybook's record SQL-STATUS-CODES is itself a level-01 entry. EXPANDS_COPY links WS-DB2-AREA (SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0051-REC-0003) to SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0017-REC-0001; WS-DB2-AREA has inline_bytes 0 and total_bytes 35 from the expansion.
